content.what_it_is: Python (numpy/matplotlib) port of the tohoku_tsunami bathymetry plot for FUNWAVE-TVD postprocessing (workshop version). It loads the ASCII depth grid depth_30min.txt from a hardcoded user path (L10), derives n,m (L13), builds geographic coordinates at 0.5-degree spacing: lon x=[float(xa)*dx+132.01667] and lat y=[float(ya)*dy-59.98333] (L14-L18), creates a 6x4-inch, 200-dpi single-subplot figure (L21-L27), plots pcolor of -1*dep with the 'terrain' colormap and tight axes (L29-L30), labels Lat/Lon (L31-L32), adds a colorbar labeled 'Bathymetry (m)' (L35-L36), and saves tsunami_bathy.png (L39).
entities: script (no function/class definitions; top-level Python script)
dep — depth grid loaded from depth_30min.txt (L10)
n, m — grid dimensions from np.shape (L13)

equations.expr: x = np.asarray([float(xa)*dx+132.01667 for xa in range(m)])
y = np.asarray([float(ya)*dy-59.98333 for ya in range(n)])

io.name: pcolor of -dep in lon/lat with terrain colormap and colorbar

unresolved: The depth file path is hardcoded to a workshop user's machine (L10); the comment at L8 mentions an fdir variable that does not actually exist in this script.
Colorbar label 'Bathymetry (m)' (L36) describes -dep values (negative down), consistent with the MATLAB '-depth (m)' label, but the sign convention is not stated in the file.
